name: Diaro Backup Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select Compare backup to count new, changed, unchanged and absent entries in a later backup.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Diaro Backup Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
